chapters.title: Boot to the front end
chapters.goal: Get past the boot and the intro to the game's front end (its title screen).
hints: The intro plays by itself; START or A skips it.
The title screen is where a new game or a saved game is chosen.

chapters.title: Create a character
chapters.goal: Start a new game and create a character.
hints: The title screen and the character creator are driven by the touch screen as well as the buttons.
Class and appearance can be changed on the creation screen; the choice only affects stats.
Name the character, then start the story.

chapters.title: Learn the town
chapters.goal: Walk around the town, talk to people and take the first quest.
hints: Quests come from the quest counter and from people in town.
Shops sell weapons, armour and healing items: buy what you can afford before leaving.
The storage (bank) holds items you are not carrying.

chapters.title: The first field
chapters.goal: Get through the first field quest and come back to town.
hints: A attacks the target in front of you; the D-pad moves.
Palette actions (healing, techniques) are used with B and the D-pad, or from the touch screen palette.
The touch screen shows the map and the enemy positions: use it to avoid being surrounded.
Return to town to heal, sell and save.

chapters.title: Keep the character equipped
chapters.goal: Upgrade the weapon and armour whenever the shops have something better.
hints: Armour and a strong weapon matter more than level alone.
Sell what you do not need: inventory space is limited.
Keep a stack of healing items in the palette before a long field.

chapters.title: Follow the story quests
chapters.goal: Keep taking story quests and clearing the fields and dungeons they lead to.
hints: Story quests are marked differently from the repeatable ones in the quest list.
Bosses appear at the end of a field: heal before you enter the room.
Save in town after every quest.
